The message below has two clearly separated sections. Speak the following text aloud naturally and clearly, in a warm, podcast announcer voice. Do not add, omit, or change any words.

I often look at the hiring dashboard. It shows time, cost, and the people we still need. If hiring slows, the work does not stop. I have seen reports of faster hiring and lower costs after using AI. That is why I may keep using it. But I heard that one tool gave women lower scores, so I look again at my own choice. If people question this choice, my name is attached. I am protecting the company’s future, but I also carry the risk of being wrong.
